title: Lower-shriek existence from a covering of representable evaluations
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $f:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a morphism of topoi, meaning an adjoint pair $f^{-1}:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ and $f_*:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ with $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ and $f^{-1}$ preserving finite limits. Suppose $E$ is a set of objects of $\mathcal D$ such that every object of $\mathcal D$ has a covering by objects of $E$, and for every $V\in E$ there is a sheaf $G_V$ on $\mathcal C$ with bijections $(f^{-1}F)(V)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)}(G_V,F)$ natural in sheaves $F$ on $\mathcal C$. Then there exists a functor $f_!:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ with bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)}(f_!G,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)}(G,f^{-1}F)$ natural in $G\in\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ and $F\in\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$. Thus $f_!\dashv f^{-1}$.
